section.intro: Edit projects with other people in real time. Projects sync through a collaboration server that you or your group runs, and that server decides who can join.

empty.title: No servers yet
empty.description: Ask the person who runs your group's server for its address, then add it here.

presence.label: What others see
presence.description: Choose what people in your shared projects see while you work. Set it separately on each computer.

options.file: Show only which file I'm in

server.signedOutHint: This computer isn't signed in to this server.
server.suspendedHint: An admin suspended your account on {{server}}. Your changes stay on this computer. You can sign in again once an admin reactivates it.
server.endedHint: You no longer have access to {{server}}. Your copies stay on this computer as ordinary projects. If an admin adds you back, sign in again.
server.endedGuestHint: You no longer have access to {{server}} because you're not in any of its shared projects. Your copies stay on this computer as ordinary projects. If you're invited again, sign in again.
server.manageHint: Manage server shows People, Allowed people, Domains, Server settings, Email and Security log here. The admin console opens in its own window and also has an overview, projects and connection checks.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeConfirm.description: Oleafly signs out of {{name}} and forgets it. Shared projects from {{name}} stop syncing and stay on this computer as ordinary projects, each renamed as a local copy.

server.detached: These shared projects from {{server}} stopped syncing. They stay on this computer as ordinary projects.

unsent.title: Some changes haven't been sent
unsent.description: These shared projects have changes the server doesn't have yet. If you keep a local copy, each one stops syncing and stays on this computer under the name shown below. Or stay signed in and try again later.
unsent.removeDescription: These shared projects have changes the server doesn't have yet. If you keep a local copy, each one stops syncing and stays on this computer under the name shown below. Or keep the server and try again later.

emails.label: Email me when someone shares a project
emails.description: The email names the project and has a link to open it.
emails.mentionsLabel: Email me when someone mentions me in a comment
emails.mentionsDescription: The email quotes the comment and has a link to open it.
emails.noMail: This server doesn't send email. Projects shared with you still show up in your library under Shared with you.
emails.paused: The server's admin has turned off email for everyone.
emails.loadFailed: Oleafly couldn't load your email settings.

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Computers signed in to this server with your account. Sign out any you no longer use.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign out {{name}}?
signOutConfirm.description: That computer stops syncing with this server until someone signs in on it again.

reachable.label: Address
reachable.fail: Oleafly couldn't reach this address. Check the address and your network.

https.label: Secure connection
https.pass: The connection is encrypted and the certificate is valid.
https.fail: The server's certificate isn't valid, or the address doesn't use https.

protocol.pass: This version of Oleafly works with the server.

protocol.info: The server is newer than this version of Oleafly but still works with it.
protocol.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

webSocket.info: Live edits take a slower route because this network blocks the usual one. They still arrive.

signInProviders.label: Sign-in options
signInProviders.pass: The server has at least one way to sign in.
signInProviders.fail: The server has no way to sign in yet. Ask its admin.
signInProviders.info: The server has a way to sign in, but some options are turned off.
signInProviders.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

email.label: Email
email.fail: The server's email settings don't work.
email.info: Email isn't set up on this server. People are added without an email.
email.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

clock.label: Clock
clock.pass: Your clock and the server's clock agree.
clock.fail: Your clock and the server's clock are far apart. Check the date and time on this computer.
clock.info: Your clock is a little off from the server's.
clock.skipped: Not checked because an earlier check failed.

addServer.title: Add a collaboration server
addServer.description: Enter the address your group gave you. Oleafly checks the server before you sign in.
addServer.notAServer: No Oleafly server answered at this address. Check the address with whoever runs the server. On hotel or campus Wi-Fi, open any web page first in case the network wants you to sign in.
addServer.moved: This address sends you to {{target}}. Try that address.
addServer.serverDescription: This server decides who can join. Choose a way to sign in.
addServer.setupDescription: Nobody has set up this server yet. If you installed it, enter the setup code the installer showed you. It's also in the server's log. The first person to sign in with the code becomes the server's admin. If you didn't install it, ask the person who runs it to finish setup first.
addServer.signInDescription: Your browser opens so you can sign in there. Oleafly never sees your password.
addServer.noProviders: This server has no way to sign in yet. Ask its admin to set one up.
addServer.waitingDescription: Sign in with {{provider}} in the browser window that opened, then come back here.
addServer.waitingEmailDescription: Enter your email address in the browser, then open the link we send you on this computer.
addServer.doneDescription: You're signed in as {{name}}. You can now share projects and open the ones shared with you.
addServer.doneManageDescription: You're signed in as {{name}}. You can now share projects and open the ones shared with you. You can also manage the server from the admin console.
addServer.doneGuestDescription: You're signed in as {{name}}. As a guest, you can open the projects you're invited to.
addServer.codeSignInDescription: Use this when your browser can't get back to Oleafly, or to sign in on another device.
addServer.codeSteps: On any phone or computer, open this address and enter the code.
addServer.codeWaiting: Waiting for you to sign in
addServer.codeOffer: Browser didn't come back to Oleafly?
addServer.codeHint: If your browser couldn't reach Oleafly, sign in with a code instead.

errors.unreachable: Oleafly couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
errors.not_https: This address doesn't use a secure connection. Collaboration servers need an address that starts with https.
errors.client_too_old: This server needs a newer version of Oleafly. Update Oleafly, then try again.
errors.server_too_old: This server needs an update before it works with this version of Oleafly. Ask its admin.
errors.not_admitted: This server hasn't let you in yet. Ask its admin to add you.
errors.sign_in_timed_out: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: You're signed out of this server. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your role on this server doesn't allow that.
errors.not_found: The server couldn't find that. It may already be gone.
errors.conflict: That clashes with a change someone else made. Reload and try again.
errors.rate_limited: The server is busy. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.setup_code_invalid: That setup code doesn't match. Check the server's log for the right code.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Try again later, or ask its admin.
errors.internal: Something went wrong in Oleafly. Try again.
errors.server_changed: This address now belongs to a different server, so Oleafly didn't send it anything. If you trust the new server, remove this one and add it again.
errors.duplicate_server: This server is already in your list under another address. If it moved, remove the old entry first, then add it again.
errors.device_in_use: Someone else already signed in to this server from this computer account. Each person needs their own account on the computer to sign in.
errors.server_unknown: This link is for a server you haven't added yet. Add it in Collaboration settings, then open the link again.
errors.too_large: Some files are bigger than this server allows. Make them smaller or remove them, then try again.
errors.invalid: The server didn't accept that. Check what you entered, then try again.
errors.invalid_domain: That isn't a domain name. Use a form like cs.example.edu.
errors.invalid_email: That email address doesn't look right. Check it, then try again.
errors.invalid_login: That sign-in name doesn't look right. Check it, then try again.
errors.guests_off: This server doesn't allow guests. Ask its admin to turn guests on.
errors.link_sharing_off: This server doesn't allow link sharing. Ask its admin to turn it on.
errors.access_log_off: This server doesn't allow access logs. Ask its admin to turn them on.
errors.last_admin: This server needs at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
errors.already_member: That person already has an account. Change their role under People.
errors.project_not_shared: This project isn't shared yet. Share it first, then invite people.
errors.project_full: This project already has as many people as the server allows. Remove someone first, or ask the server's admin.
errors.owner_away: The project's owner is suspended or removed on this server, so the project can't take new people until their account is active again.
errors.wrong_server: This server sent its sign-in page from a different address, so Oleafly stopped. Check the server address, or ask the person who runs it.
errors.not_a_link: That isn't a link to a shared project. Copy the whole link, then try again.
errors.signed_out: You're signed out of this server. Sign in again to sync this project.
errors.server_removed: This project's server isn't in your list any more. Keep the project as a local copy, or add the server again.
errors.share_in_progress: This project is already being shared. Wait for that to finish.
errors.cancelled: Opening the shared project was cancelled.
errors.cloud_synced: Your Oleafly library is in a folder that a cloud service syncs. Move it out of Dropbox, OneDrive or iCloud Drive to share or join projects.

members.devicesDescription: Sign out a device that is lost or no longer used.

selfRoleConfirm.description: You'll lose your admin rights on this server, and only another admin can give them back.

deviceSignOutConfirm.title: Sign out {{name}}?
deviceSignOutConfirm.description: That device stops syncing with this server until its owner signs in on it again.

domains.description: Anyone with a verified email address at these domains can sign in with the role you pick.

settings.description: These settings apply to everyone on this server.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change these settings.

guestsEnabled.label: Allow guests
guestsEnabled.description: Members can invite people from outside the server to projects they own.

guestApprovalRequired.label: Approve guests first
guestApprovalRequired.description: A maintainer or admin approves each guest invitation before it works.

directoryVisible.label: Member directory
directoryVisible.description: Members can look each other up by name when they share a project.

directoryShowsEmail.label: Show email addresses in the directory
directoryShowsEmail.description: Members see each other's email addresses when they look someone up.

linkSharingAllowed.label: Allow link sharing
linkSharingAllowed.description: Project owners can let any member open a project from its link.

accessLogsAllowed.label: Allow project access logs
accessLogsAllowed.description: Project owners can keep a log of who opened their project.

commentsAllowed.label: Allow comments
commentsAllowed.description: People in shared projects can comment on text and reply. Turning this off hides comments everywhere and keeps them stored.

emailNotifications.label: Email notifications
emailNotifications.description: Send these emails. Turn this off to stop them for everyone on the server.

emailLinkSignIn.label: Sign in by email
emailLinkSignIn.description: People can sign in with a link sent to their email address. This needs the server's email settings. Your access rules still decide who gets in.

share.tooLarge: These files are over the server's limit of {{size}} MB. Make them smaller or remove them before you share.
share.renamed: Some names don't work on every computer. Other people get these files under a slightly different name.

share.trustAgain: Anyone you add to this project can change its files, so Oleafly asks you to trust it again on this computer before it runs agents, terminal commands or shell escape for it.
